summary: T.E.R.E.S.A. iteration 4 — full stack regression + new 3-role doctor workflow. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass (auth + 3 roles, legacy 'patient' migration, readings with new state_system, sessions, alerts, contacts, calendar, full doctor flow including create-patient/list-linked-only/data-with-latest_reading/send-alert, cross-doctor 403 isolation, AND the real-LLM wound-feedback cycle: patient photo → doctor rates 5★ → patient fetches photo with embedded feedback). Frontend parser unit-check: parseTeresaTelemetry('TEMP=36.8;HUM=52.4;STATE=EM_TRATAMENTO') returns {temperature_c:36.8, humidity_pct:52.4, state:'EM_TRATAMENTO'}; empty/garbage/missing-TEMP/NaN inputs all return null; unknown STATE collapses to 'DESCONHECIDO'. BLE UUID constants match firmware exactly (TERESA_SERVICE_UUID 7b4c0001-…, TELEMETRY 7b4c0002-…, COMMAND 7b4c0003-…, TARGET 'TERESA01'). UI (mobile viewport 390x844): Register screen shows all 3 role toggles; after monitored-register Home shows card-equipment-status / status-dot / status-text / treatment-state / metric-temperature / metric-humidity / wound-analysis / alerts / contacts; after autonomous-register Home shows card-autonomous-info and the equipment+metrics are correctly ABSENT; after doctor-register Home shows doctor-patient-picker with empty patient-picker-list; Profile → btn-add-patient opens modal with add-patient-monitored/autonomous toggles + name/email/password/age/lesion inputs + btn-save-patient; after saving, the created patient appears in picker-item-* list and selecting it renders doctor-patient-header card. Contacts card button label is 'WhatsApp' (1 occurrence on monitored Home). Settings → 'Exportar relatório' tap does not crash. Only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) — no page errors, no red screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-fatal, web-only. Likely from third-party deps (react-navigation / expo components). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/(tabs)/home.tsx and shared Card component.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Web preview only; native build will not warn. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate `shadow*` and `props.pointerEvents` usages to `boxShadow` / `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings (purely cosmetic — no functional impact).
Optional: audit `useNativeDriver: true` usages to be gated by Platform.OS !== 'web' to remove the web-only warning.

server.py:357 assert_doctor_owns_patient correctly 403s on both non-doctor callers (via require_doctor) AND doctors not linked to the patient (doctor_id check). Verified by TestDoctorAuthorization + test_other_doctor_cannot_* tests.

server.py:694 save_feedback upserts on (photo_id, doctor_id) — safe for repeated submissions and matches the embedded-feedback contract in /wound-photos/{id}. GET returns feedback via _photo_response which looks it up fresh.
server.py:869 POST /doctor/patients returns 201 with doctor_id set from the authenticated doctor — matches spec (one-doctor model).
ble.ts:448 parseTeresaTelemetry is pure and import-safe (no RN deps) — unit-verified above with 6 cases including the exact spec payload. UUIDs match firmware.
